architecture.spaces: constant=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5 (declared but unused), join=6; byte addressed, wordsize 1, all little-endian
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/AddrSpace inserts ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace and two IPTR_PROCESSOR AddrSpaces (ram index 3, register index 4) with AddrSpace::hasphysical; JoinSpace index 6 is constructed for the join ParamEntry spaceids (its own resolver window is never queried)

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; staged ParamEntry resources (case1: five plain force-left exclusion entries reg [0x100,0x107] min1 / reg [0x200,0x207] min4 / ram [0x2000,0x200F] min8 / reg [0x108,0x10F] min1 / reg [0x104,0x10F] min1; case2+4: join reg:0x104+reg:0x100 (4B each) min4 plus plain reg [0x100,0x107] min8; case3: cross-space join ram:0x200+reg:0x200 min4)
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built ParamEntry/ParamListStandard/JoinRecord via the staged loader (C++ direct field writes under the class->struct access hack, Rust pub builder setters + set_join_pieces); populateResolver completes each model

analysis_options.api: Direct production ParamListStandard::findEntry and characterizeAsParam calls on both sides; no Action, Rule, PrintC or Funcdata pipeline
analysis_options.model_state: case1: ParamListStandard with five plain entries, 14 (space,offset,size,just) queries; case2: join + overlapping plain entry, 6 queries; case3: cross-space join, 4 queries; case4: the case-2 model, 5 queries observed through BOTH findEntry(loc,size,true) and characterizeAsParam
analysis_options.normalization: None. Entry ordinals (position in the entry list) or null, and raw characterizeAsParam classification codes (0..3), are printed verbatim
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all queries stay on valid inputs

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: ParamListStandard with five plain force-left exclusion entries (reg [0x100,0x107] min1, reg [0x200,0x207] min4, ram [0x2000,0x200F] min8, reg [0x108,0x10F] min1, reg [0x104,0x10F] min1), populateResolver
cases.queries: 14 rows: fe spc/off/sz/just -> entry ordinal or null
cases.expect: fspec.cc:661-680 visits only the resolver->find(loc.getOffset()) window: extent-out queries (below/between/above every same-space extent, or in a foreign/unresolved space) return null EVEN with just=false; the in-window minSize gate returns null rather than falling through to an out-of-window earlier entry; the in-window overlap query at 0x104 returns e0 under just=false (position order = entry list order) and e4 under just=true

cases.setup: join ParamEntry (pieces MS-first reg:0x104 high + reg:0x100 low, min4) followed by plain reg [0x100,0x107] min8, populateResolver
cases.queries: 6 rows: fe spc/off/sz/just -> entry ordinal or null
cases.expect: populateResolver fspec.cc:1191-1216 registers the join entry per piece in the piece space, so findEntry returns the join entry: just=false hits at 0x100/0x104 return e0 (the join), just=true returns e0 only when the join walk (fspec.cc:253-261, least significant piece first) yields offset 0 (0x100/4), while 0x100/8 (join walk -1, plain justified) returns e1 and 0x104/4 (offset 4) and 0x102/4 (poke-out) return null

cases.setup: join ParamEntry with pieces in DIFFERENT spaces (MS-first ram:0x200 high + reg:0x200 low, min4), populateResolver
cases.queries: 4 rows: fe spc/off/sz/just -> entry ordinal or null
cases.expect: the reg query hits the low piece (justified offset 0 -> e0); the ram query hits the high piece numerically but the foreign low piece takes address.cc:133 base != op2.base -1 so the walk returns offset 4 != 0 -> null with just=true; just=false returns e0 from either piece window; 0x204 is outside both piece extents -> null

cases.setup: the join_piece_access model queried through both findEntry(loc,size,true) and characterizeAsParam
cases.expect: the shared phase-1 resolver window ties a justified find hit to contains_justified (0x100/4 -> e0 + ch=2; 0x100/8 -> e1 + ch=2), an in-window unjustified start to contains_unjustified with a null find (0x104/4), an above-all-extents start to the closed gate (0x110 -> null + ch=0) and a below-all start with failing containedBy (0xFC/8 -> null + ch=0)

observation_schema.format: 34 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, four case headers, then 14 fe rows, 6 fe rows, 4 fe rows and 5 fc rows
observation_schema.branches: fe rows print the entry ordinal (position in the entry list) or null; ordinals are stable because both sides stage the same entry list in the same order
observation_schema.classification: fc rows print the findEntry(loc,size,true) ordinal/null and the raw characterizeAsParam code (no_containment=0, contains_unjustified=1, contains_justified=2, contained_by=3)

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: findEntry returns a const ParamEntry* (Rugra: entry-list ordinal, Some/None); justifiedContain returns int4 (-1 or the endian-aware distance); characterizeAsParam consumes the justifiedContain sign and the exclusion containedBy; no callee mutates model state
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: findEntry walks ONLY the resolver->find(loc.getOffset()) window (the single refined subinterval containing the query start): its records share one last key and iterate in position order, and populateResolver assigns positions in entry-list order (join entries per piece, MS piece first), so Rugra's ordered entry-list scan visits exactly the window in exactly Ghidra's order; the minSize check (cc:675) precedes the just check (cc:676)
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: the join walk accumulator res (fspec.cc:252) adds vdata.size only for pieces the query does NOT contain (cur < 0, including the address.cc:133 foreign-space -1) and returns res + cur on the first containing piece; findEntry itself has no accumulator
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: the window membership key is numeric extent containment of the query start in the query's space (registered per entry or per join piece); the just=true acceptance key is justifiedContain == 0 with per-piece/entry space equality; the find-window boundary is the refinement's nearest boundary above the query start (shared by every record covering the start)

residuals.detail: BE-space rows and the spaceless wrapper's remaining callers (assumed_extension, ParamListStandardOut::possible_param join access): the enum AddressSpace model is little-endian-only and those callers have no query space in hand.

Join-entry resolver windows are now exercised end to end: populateResolver per-piece registration drives both find_entry windows (join_piece_access, cross_space_join cases) and characterize_as_param phase-1/phase-2 windows (find_vs_characterize case, join in phase-1 window with containedBy structurally false via the space guard), including the per-piece address.cc:133 foreign-space -1 (R13 finding B).

find_entry now replicates the fspec.cc:661-680 resolver find-window gating (extent containment of the query start in the query's space, minSize inside the window, space-aware justifiedContain) and reaches join entries; 29 oracle rows MATCH.
